description: Resolve a listing link (Airbnb, Booking, Vrbo) to the operator's Ospitario passport, e.g. when a traveler wants to book a place they know directly. Exact match on the listing's own L2/L2c proof or found:false; never a list; a property verified only as an operator (L3) or an unclaimed passport (L0) is never returned for a link. The link is only parsed, never opened. Insurance status and safety equipment are host-declared, not verified: Ospitario has seen no policy and no device. Every result is a property with a proven listing (L2/L2c), a verified operator (L3), a right to manage verified by document review (LA) or, marked L0 and unclaimed, facts from the operator's official website with nothing proven; the result names the tier and the date it was reached, and whether the registration number (Italy: CIN) was checked against the public register. Contact is direct with the operator and commission-free, so the traveler pays no platform fee. No result means nothing proven matches; nothing is inferred, estimated or filled in.

lang.description: Language of labels in the result; defaults to en

url.description: Link to a listing on Airbnb, Booking or Vrbo

name: lookup_by_url

contactPageUrl.description: Page with the passport and the operator's direct contact; give this link to the traveler

amenities.description: Amenities in the operator's own words

lastSync.description: Last successful calendar sync, ISO timestamp

status.description: calendar: blocked dates come from the operator's calendar, synced recently (lastSync); unblocked nights are not confirmed free; on_request: the operator answers availability on request, no dates are published; unknown: no current calendar, ask the operator. Availability is a hint, never a booking commitment: a night not blocked in the operator's synced calendar may already be taken, since the calendar is a copy that can lag behind; only the operator confirms availability, and Ospitario holds or books nothing.

bathrooms.description: Bathrooms; a half bath counts 0.5. null: not stated.

beds.description: Beds by kind as the operator states them; null: not stated

blocked.description: Blocked date ranges from the operator's calendar as last synced; a night not listed is not confirmed free

booking.description: What a traveler can do with this passport: contact the operator, never book through Ospitario. Availability is separate (availability, blocked)

bookable.description: Always false: Ospitario takes no bookings and no payment. A result, a free night or a sent inquiry reserves nothing; the operator confirms dates and price

contact.description: direct: the operator's own channels are in contact, and send_inquiry mails the operator; relay_only: unclaimed, write with send_inquiry (the official website in contact.site is the operator's own page, not an inquiry channel of Ospitario). send_inquiry may still refuse, with a reason

checkinFrom.description: Check-in from, HH:MM local time; null: not stated

checkoutUntil.description: Checkout until, HH:MM local time; null: not stated (a stated 00:00, usually 12:00 AM typed for noon, counts as not stated)

childrenAllowed.description: Whether children are welcome, as the operator states it; null: not stated

cleaningFee.description: Cleaning fee per stay as the operator states it; null: not stated (which is not the same as none; see extraCosts)

contact.description: Direct contact of the operator; no commission and no intermediary

eventsAllowed.description: Whether parties or events are allowed, as the operator states it; null: not stated

extraCosts.description: Costs beyond the nightly price in the operator's words (cleaning, tourist tax, linen, energy); null: not stated, which is not the same as none (a bare number without what or currency counts as not stated)

facilities.description: true: there, false: stated absent, null: not stated. The operator's yes/no wins; otherwise read from the amenity lines by fixed patterns, as for the pool

workspace.description: A place to work (desk); not a statement about the internet speed

floorArea.description: Living area in square metres as the operator states it; null: not stated

languages.description: Languages the operator speaks, as written on their website (unclaimed passports)

anyOf.description: Liability insurance (RC). Insurance status and safety equipment are host-declared, not verified: Ospitario has seen no policy and no device. null: the operator said nothing. The traveler should ask the operator for the policy before booking; platform guarantees (e.g. AirCover) do not cover direct bookings.

insurer.description: Insurer as named by the operator

status.description: declared: the operator states a liability insurance (RC) policy; none: the operator states there is none

validUntil.description: End of the policy as stated by the operator, YYYY-MM-DD

location.description: Exact location and address, only when the operator chose to publish them; never for an unclaimed passport

minNights.description: Minimum stay in nights as the operator states it; null: not stated, ask the operator

petsAllowed.description: Whether pets are allowed, as the operator states it; null: not stated, ask the operator.

placeKind.description: What the guest rents: the entire place, a private room or a shared room. Declared by the operator; null: not stated.

pool.description: The pool, facet by facet; null: not stated. Never inferred.

access.description: null: not stated, or the lines disagree

heated.description: true: a heated or heatable pool. It does not say the pool is heated on given dates: see heatedSeason and heating. null: not stated

heatedSeason.description: Days the pool is heated every year, MM-DD to MM-DD; null: not declared, or several periods (see heatedSeasons)

heatedSeasons.description: Every period the pool is heated each year; empty: not declared

heating.description: As the operator declares it: no heating, heating included, heating for a surcharge, heating on request (notice in notes); null: not declared

notes.description: Conditions in the operator's words: surcharge, notice for heating, hours, age rules

present.description: true: the operator declares a pool, or a line names a pool of the house; false: declared or stated absent; null: not stated

season.description: Days the pool is open every year, MM-DD to MM-DD inclusive (may run across New Year); null when several periods are declared (see seasons); null: not declared, ask the operator

seasons.description: Every period the pool is open each year, as the operator declares them; empty: not declared, ask the operator

source.description: operator: declared in the passport's pool fields; amenity_text: read from the amenity lines by fixed patterns in six languages, a line that places the pool elsewhere (public, nearby) does not count; null: nothing about a pool

anyOf.description: Indicative price per night. Prices are indicative, stated by the host (on an unclaimed passport: taken from the official website), negotiated directly with the host; there is no booking through Ospitario. null: the operator gave no price.

nightlyFrom.description: Lowest nightly price among the current and future periods

seasons.description: Current and future periods; ended ones are left out

nightlyFrom.description: Lowest nightly price the operator states for this period

seasonLabel.description: Season name in the operator's words

validFrom.description: First day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD; null: no start given

validTo.description: Last day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD; null: no end given

updatedAt.description: When the operator last changed the prices, YYYY-MM-DD

propertyKind.description: Kind of building from a fixed list (farmhouse: masseria, casale; trullo: Apulian trullo); type keeps the operator's own word. null: not stated

provenance.description: Where the passport's facts come from; a proof level is about the operator and the listings, not about the house's features

facts.description: Who states the description, capacity, rooms, amenities, pool, rules and price: the operator through their account, or (unclaimed) the operator's official website as read by Ospitario

factsUpdatedAt.description: Last change of these facts, ISO timestamp; null: unknown. Calendar sync and verification have their own dates (availability.lastSync, verification.date)

recordDate.description: Last change of the register record, YYYY-MM-DD

source.description: The register and its publisher, as the licence asks to name them

register.description: Unclaimed only: the regional register completed facts the website does not state (CIN, municipality, category, beds, rooms); null: none from a register

verified.description: These facts are not checked by Ospitario. What is checked is named elsewhere: verification, references and trust (who may rent, which listings), registration.status (the number against the register)

province.description: Region code, ISO 3166-2 without the country prefix: IT/ES province (LE, GR), FR département (75), DE Land (HH), PT distrito (11)

references.description: Platform listings proven to belong to this operator, each with its own tier, date and passed proofs

listingId.description: The platform's own listing id (Booking: country/slug)

proofs.description: Passed proofs only, with method and date

method.description: How listing control was proven. airbnb_calendar: the operator's Airbnb calendar export link carries the listing id; date_challenge: Ospitario named a random date, and the operator blocked it in the platform's calendar export within 48 hours (not used for new proofs since 2026-11-07); platform_email: a platform email to the operator with a valid DKIM signature; channel_manager: the operator's channel manager lists the listing.

checkedAt.description: Day the number was last found in the official source (YYYY-MM-DD); a match of the code, never a check of the operator's identity

number.description: The registration number as the operator declared it (Italy: CIN); checked only as far as status says

source.description: The official source that confirmed the number, with its licence; null when none did

status.description: unchecked: the operator declared the country's short-term rental registration number (Italy: CIN), not yet checked against the public register; exists: the number is in the register; missing: the register no longer lists it.

registration.description: Registration number status; null if the operator gave none

safety.description: Safety equipment the operator states is present. Insurance status and safety equipment are host-declared, not verified: Ospitario has seen no policy and no device. An item not listed is absent or not stated: see safetyStated.

safetyStated.description: Each safety item: true present, false stated absent, null not stated. Insurance status and safety equipment are host-declared, not verified: Ospitario has seen no policy and no device.

securityDeposit.description: Security deposit per stay as the operator states it; null: not stated

smokingAllowed.description: Whether smoking is allowed inside, as the operator states it; null: not stated

stepFreeAccess.description: Whether the home can be entered without steps, as the operator states it; null: not stated. Not an accessibility certification

summary.description: Two neutral sentences composed automatically from the facts of an unclaimed passport; not the operator's words

trust.description: What Ospitario verified, by area: the managing account, authority over the property, platform listings

managedByHost.description: A host account with a confirmed email manages this passport; false for an unclaimed (L0) passport. A confirmed email proves nothing about the property

propertyAuthority.description: Proofs that this operator may represent the property; empty when none. Independent of platform listings

method.description: operator_eid: eID identity matched to the registration holder (L3, Italy); document_review: documents checked by Ospitario's admin (LA)

verifiedListings.description: Platform listings with their own listing-control proof (see references); 0 is normal for a property without platforms

type.description: Accommodation type as stated by the operator

unclaimed.description: true: an unclaimed passport (tier L0) built from the operator's official website; email and phone are not shown, write with send_inquiry

unitCount.description: Separately rentable homes this passport describes; 1: one home; more: ask the operator which unit the facts are for; null: not stated

date.description: Date the tier was reached, YYYY-MM-DD

tier.description: Verification tier (docs: ADR 0012, 0017, 0024, 0025). L0 unclaimed: facts read from the operator's official website, nothing proven, the operator has not claimed the page; contact only through send_inquiry. L2 listing verified: the operator proved control of the platform listing (calendar export link with the listing id, platform email with a valid DKIM signature, or channel manager); since 2026-11-07 also their right to manage the property (LA or L3), and earlier L2 stands as it was reached. L2c listing calendar proven (Booking, Vrbo): the operator blocked a random date Ospitario named in that platform's calendar export within 48 hours; no new L2c since 2026-11-07. LA right-to-manage documents reviewed: Ospitario's admin checked documents tying the operator to this property (registration record, deed, lease, mandate or company register); a person found them consistent, without eID, so it does not prove who holds the account and never proves a platform listing. L3 operator verified: the operator's eID identity (SPID/CIE) matches the CIN holder in the national register's PDF. L4 document verified (automated check): an ownership, lease or mandate document is consistent with that identity and the property; it states consistency, not authenticity. L5 manually verified: a reviewer checked the document (an optional upgrade; it does not affect search order).

verification.description: Strongest current tier of the property and its listings

reason.description: not_found: no operator holds a listing-control proof (L2/L2c) on this listing; unsupported_url: not a listing link Ospitario understands

title: Look up a listing link
